title: 자체 실전 모의 A
description: 직접 만든 실전 모의고사예요. 공식 문항이 아니에요. 공유 자전거 대여 시간을 예측하는 14문항을 풀어요. 90분을 직접 재며 풀어요. 힌트는 없어요. 분석 30점, 전처리 30점, 모델링 40점이에요. 자체 목표는 90점이고, 공식 합격선은 80점이에요. 필수 문제 14개와 선택 도전 0개예요.

tasks.title: 문항 1 · 6점 · 도구 별칭 불러오기
tasks.goal:
자, 실전 모의 A를 시작해요. 시험지처럼 요구사항만 드려요.
분석에 쓸 도구를 별칭(as 뒤의 이름)으로 불러오세요.

pandas는 `pd`, numpy는 `np`라는 별칭으로 불러오세요.
사이킷런(`sklearn`)은 `sk`라는 별칭으로 불러오세요.
답은 `# [문항 1]` 줄 바로 아래에 쓰세요.
`# 확인 셀이에요.` 줄부터 끝까지는 고치지 마세요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

def figures():
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is None:
        return []
    import numpy as np
    def numbers(values):
        try:
            return [round(float(v), 4) for v in np.asarray(values, dtype=float).ravel()]
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return [str(v) for v in values]
    shapes = []
    for number in plt.get_fignums():
        figure = plt.figure(number)
        figure.canvas.draw()
        for ax in figure.axes:
            bars = sorted((round(p.get_x(), 4), round(p.get_width(), 4), round(p.get_y(), 4), round(p.get_height(), 4))
                          for p in ax.patches if type(p).__name__ == 'Rectangle')
            lines = [numbers(line.get_xdata()) + ['|'] + numbers(line.get_ydata()) for line in ax.get_lines()]
            points = []
            for collection in ax.collections:
                offsets = np.asarray(collection.get_offsets())
                if offsets.size:
                    points.append(sorted(tuple(round(float(v), 4) for v in row) for row in offsets.reshape(-1, 2)))
                values = collection.get_array() if hasattr(collection, 'get_array') else None
                if values is not None and getattr(values, 'size', 0):
                    points.append(numbers(values))
            # texts: numbers written on cells, such as a heatmap drawn with annot=True.
            shapes.append(dict(title=ax.get_title(), xlabel=ax.get_xlabel(), ylabel=ax.get_ylabel(),
                xticks=[t.get_text() for t in ax.get_xticklabels()], yticks=[t.get_text() for t in ax.get_yticklabels()],
                bars=bars, lines=sorted(lines, key=str), points=sorted(points, key=str),
                texts=sorted(t.get_text() for t in ax.texts)))
    return shapes


class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    scope['__figures__'] = figures()
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

# 표 도구 pandas를 pd라는 별칭으로 불러와요.
import pandas as pd

# 앞 문항까지 처리한 코드예요. 미리 실행돼 있어요.
# 대여 정보(JSON)와 주행 기록(CSV)을 읽어요. 직접 만든 자료예요.
info = pd.read_json('data/rental_info.json')
ride = pd.read_csv('data/rental_ride.csv')
# info를 첫 번째 표로 넣고, 두 표에 모두 있는 대여만 남겨요(inner).
df = pd.merge(info, ride, on='rental_id', how='inner')
# humidity의 '-'는 결측으로 바꾸며 숫자로 만들어요.
df['humidity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['humidity'], errors='coerce')
# [문항 5] 여기에 답안코드를 작성하세요.
# 다섯 숫자 열의 상관계수 표예요.
corr = df[['distance', 'temp', 'humidity', 'hour', 'minutes']].corr()

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)


MESSAGES = {'__figures__': '그래프의 종류·축 이름·값이 기준 그래프와 달라요. 바뀐 자료로도 같은 그래프를 그리세요.'}
for index, case in enumerate(cases):
    values = {k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != 'files'}
    files = {**base_files, **case.get('files', {})}
    expected, wanted, made = run_in_fresh_folder(files, reference, values)
    changed = '준비 값을 ' + describe(case) + '(으)로 바꾸면 '
    try:
        actual, scope, produced = run_in_fresh_folder(files, source, values)
    except SystemExit:
        fail('코드가 exit로 중간에 끝났어요. 끝까지 실행되게 하세요.')
    except BaseException as error:
        reason = ''.join(traceback.format_exception_only(type(error), error)).strip()
        fail(('코드를 실행하면' if index == 0 else changed.rstrip()) + ' 오류가 나요.
' + reason)
    if index == 0:
        problem = '실행 결과가 기대와 달라요.'
    else:
        problem = changed + '결과가 달라요.
값이나 자료가 바뀌어도 맞는 방법인지 확인하세요.'
    if actual != expected:
        fail(problem + '
기대 출력:
' + expected[-600:] + '
실제 출력:
' + actual[-600:])
    for name in names:
        if name not in scope:
            fail(name + '에 결과를 담아 주세요.')
        if not same(scope[name], wanted[name]):
            fail(problem + '
' + MESSAGES.get(name, name + '의 값이 기대와 달라요.'))
    for path in sorted(made):
        if path not in produced:
            fail(problem + '
' + path + ' 파일을 저장하지 않았어요.')
        if produced[path] != made[path]:
            fail(problem + '
저장한 ' + path + ' 파일의 내용이 기대와 달라요.')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():

        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    return ', '.join(parts)

남은 결측을 처리하세요. 열마다 방법이 달라요.

`temp`가 빈 행은 지우세요.
그다음 `humidity` 빈칸을 남은 행의 `humidity` 중앙값으로 채우세요.

# humidity의 '-'는 결측으로 바꾸며 숫자로 만들어요.

# info를 첫 번째 표로 넣고, 두 표에 모두 있는 대여만 남겨요(inner).

# humidity의 '-'는 결측으로 바꾸며 숫자로 만들어요.
df['humidity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['humidity'], errors='coerce')
# 300분 이상(반납 누락)인 행을 지워요. 행 번호는 그대로예요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

' + reason)

tasks.goal:
글자 열 `user_type`, `bike_type`을 원핫 인코딩하세요.
원핫 인코딩은 범주 값마다 0/1 열을 하나씩 만들어요.

`pd.get_dummies`로 이 두 열만 바꾸고 결과를 `df`에 다시 담으세요.
새 열은 0과 1의 정수(`dtype=int`)로 만들어요.
범주마다 열을 모두 남겨요. 첫 범주 열도 지우지 않아요.

# humidity의 '-'는 결측으로 바꾸며 숫자로 만들어요.

# 바꾸기 전 열 이름이에요.

# humidity의 '-'는 결측으로 바꾸며 숫자로 만들어요.

# 300분 이상(반납 누락)인 행을 지워요. 행 번호는 그대로예요.
df = df[df['minutes'] < 300]
# temp가 빈 행을 지운 뒤 humidity 빈칸은 중앙값으로 채워요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

입력 X와 정답 y를 정하고 훈련·테스트 자료로 나누세요.

`X`는 `df`에서 `rental_id`와 `minutes`를 뺀 열이에요. `y`는 `minutes`예요.
`train_test_split`으로 테스트 20%, `random_state=42`로 나누세요.
결과는 `X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test`에 담아요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

결정트리는 비교용으로 미리 학습해 뒀어요.

`RandomForestRegressor`로 `rf`를 만드세요.
인자는 `n_estimators=50, max_depth=5, min_samples_split=3, random_state=42`예요.
`x_train`, `y_train`으로 학습하고 `x_test`를 예측하세요.
테스트 MAE를 `답안11`에 담으세요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

    files = {**base_files, **case.get('files', {})}

        fail(('코드를 실행하면' if index == 0 else changed.rstrip()) + ' 오류가 나요.
' + reason)
    if index == 0:

    else:
        problem = changed + '결과가 달라요.
값이나 자료가 바뀌어도 맞는 방법인지 확인하세요.'
    if actual != expected:
        fail(problem + '
기대 출력:
' + expected[-600:] + '
실제 출력:
' + actual[-600:])
    for name in names:
        if name not in scope:
            fail(name + '에 결과를 담아 주세요.')
        if not same(scope[name], wanted[name]):
            fail(problem + '
' + MESSAGES.get(name, name + '의 값이 기대와 달라요.'))
    for path in sorted(made):

' + path + ' 파일을 저장하지 않았어요.')
        if produced[path] != made[path]:

저장한 ' + path + ' 파일의 내용이 기대와 달라요.')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

tasks.goal:
신경망 회귀 모델을 EarlyStopping과 함께 학습하세요.
불러오기와 시드 고정은 `[사전 실행 코드]` 부분에 있어요.
모델과 compile도 준비 코드에 주어져요.

`EarlyStopping`을 `es`에 만드세요. `val_loss`를 보고, `patience=5`예요.
가장 좋던 가중치로 돌아가게 `restore_best_weights=True`를 주세요.
`model.fit`의 결과를 `history`에 담으세요.
인자는 `x_train, y_train, validation_split=0.2, epochs=50, batch_size=16`이에요.
`callbacks=[es]`와 `verbose=0`도 넣어요.
실제로 학습한 epoch 수를 `history`의 기록으로 세어 `답안13`에 담으세요.

df = pd.merge(info, ride, on='rental_id', how='inner')

df['humidity'] = pd.to_numeric(df['humidity'], errors='coerce')

df = df[df['minutes'] < 300]
# temp가 빈 행을 지운 뒤 humidity 빈칸은 중앙값으로 채워요.
df = df.dropna(subset=['temp'])
df['humidity'] = df['humidity'].fillna(df['humidity'].median())
# 글자 열 두 개를 0과 1의 정수 열로 바꿔요.
df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['user_type', 'bike_type'], dtype=int)

X = df.drop(columns=['rental_id', 'minutes'])

# [주어진 코드] 신경망 회귀 모델이에요. 출력은 숫자 1칸이에요.
model = Sequential([

])

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)

def figures():
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is None:
        return []
    import numpy as np
    def numbers(values):
        try:
            return [round(float(v), 4) for v in np.asarray(values, dtype=float).ravel()]
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return [str(v) for v in values]
    shapes = []
    for number in plt.get_fignums():
        figure = plt.figure(number)
        figure.canvas.draw()
        for ax in figure.axes:
            bars = sorted((round(p.get_x(), 4), round(p.get_width(), 4), round(p.get_y(), 4), round(p.get_height(), 4))
                          for p in ax.patches if type(p).__name__ == 'Rectangle')
            lines = [numbers(line.get_xdata()) + ['|'] + numbers(line.get_ydata()) for line in ax.get_lines()]
            points = []
            for collection in ax.collections:
                offsets = np.asarray(collection.get_offsets())
                if offsets.size:
                    points.append(sorted(tuple(round(float(v), 4) for v in row) for row in offsets.reshape(-1, 2)))
                values = collection.get_array() if hasattr(collection, 'get_array') else None
                if values is not None and getattr(values, 'size', 0):
                    points.append(numbers(values))
            # texts: numbers written on cells, such as a heatmap drawn with annot=True.
            shapes.append(dict(title=ax.get_title(), xlabel=ax.get_xlabel(), ylabel=ax.get_ylabel(),
                xticks=[t.get_text() for t in ax.get_xticklabels()], yticks=[t.get_text() for t in ax.get_yticklabels()],
                bars=bars, lines=sorted(lines, key=str), points=sorted(points, key=str),
                texts=sorted(t.get_text() for t in ax.texts)))
    return shapes


class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    scope['__figures__'] = figures()
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)


def describe(case):
    parts = [name + ' = ' + repr(value) for name, value in case.items() if name != 'files']
    parts += [path + ' 내용' for path in case.get('files', {})]
    return ', '.join(parts)
